kilindi.hook: Fifteen white-domed pavilions on a hillside facing Tumbatu, built first as Benny Andersson's private retreat.
kilindi.why: Before Elewana took it over, Kilindi was designed as a private retreat for Benny Andersson of ABBA, and the plan still reads that way: fifteen domed pavilions spread over about fifty acres of hillside above the beach, each out of sight of the next, with slatted shutters where glass would be. Each pavilion has two rainwater plunge pools with a waterfall running between them. In 2025 Travel + Leisure readers voted it the number one resort in Africa.

zuri-zanzibar.why: Zuri was drawn by the London architects Jestico + Whiles and became the first hotel anywhere to receive EarthCheck's Sustainable Design Gold certification. nungwi-fish-market.hook: Nungwi's working fish landing by the pier, where the night's catch comes ashore and is sold off the sand.
nungwi-fish-market.why: This is where Nungwi's boats come in, beside the fishing pier at the village's working end of the beach, and where the catch is sold before it goes to any kitchen on the strip. The beach restaurants nearby lay the day's fish on a table by the grill, and you point at the one you want. Coming here first shows you what the north tip's menus are built from, and roughly what that fish costs before a hotel adds its margin.

fisherman-local.why: Fisherman Local is a plain room on the road behind Eden Villa Resort, set back from Kendwa's beach bars, and it cooks seafood at local prices. Reviewers keep coming back to the octopus, which they describe as properly tender, and to the grilled lobster, Indian-style prawn masala, tuna salad and the kitchen's own chilli sauce. It is not on the sand, which is a large part of why the prices are lower.
facts: Located on the road behind Eden Villa Resort, Kendwa (Wanderlog).
Menu highlights: Indian prawn masala, grilled lobster, octopus, tuna salad, homemade chilli sauce (aggregator reviews).
Reviewers single out the octopus for tenderness (Wanderlog).

essence-kendwa.hook: The Amaan Kendwa resort restaurant, with tandoori and butter chicken next to Zanzibar seafood curry.
essence-kendwa.why: Essence is the restaurant at Amaan Kendwa Beach Resort, and the menu spans several cooking traditions. Tandoori chicken, butter chicken and kadai chicken with naan sit next to a Zanzibar seafood coconut curry, lobster linguine and pad thai. Reviewers name the executive chef, Ali, who comes out to the tables. When you have had several nights of grilled fish on Kendwa sand, this is the nearest Indian menu.
facts: Restaurant at Amaan Kendwa Beach Resort, Kendwa (Wanderlog).
Menu includes tandoori chicken, butter chicken, kadai chicken with butter naan, Zanzibar seafood coconut curry, lobster linguine and pad thai (Wanderlog).
Listed hours 09:00-23:00; listed phone +255 779 941 555 (Wanderlog).
Executive Chef Ali is named by reviewers (Wanderlog).

sexy-fish.hook: The Z Hotel's beachfront restaurant in Nungwi: lobster tempura, crab curry and tuna ceviche, served al fresco.
sexy-fish.why: Sexy Fish is the beachfront restaurant of The Z Hotel on Nungwi's west beach. It is an open-air room with white tablecloths, and one reviewer described it as sitting above the ocean. The kitchen mixes African and European cooking around seafood: lobster tempura, crab curry, tuna ceviche, tandoori octopus with a mint dip. One guide records a format of one main course or three starters for US$36, which is the way to try more of the menu.
facts: Sexy Fish is The Z Hotel's signature al fresco beachfront restaurant (Tropical Sky).
African-European fusion seafood: lobster tempura, crab curry, tuna ceviche (Tropical Sky).
Reviewers mention tandoori octopus with mint dip and lobster lollipop in crispy bacon (reviews via search).
Offers a main course or three starters for US$36 (guide via search).
Half- and full-board guests can eat at Sexy Fish or Cinnamon (hotel rates page via search).
